Balcony Glazing
Lumon Balcony Glazing

Lumon balcony glazing systems create more usable living space by protecting balconies from wind, rain, dust, and noise while maintaining open views and fresh air access. The frameless retractable glazing can be opened or closed depending on the weather, helping homeowners enjoy their balconies for more months each year. Custom-made glazing solutions also improve balcony safety, facade protection, and long-term property value.

Why balcony glazing
When wind, rain and cool temperatures would otherwise keep you and your family inside, our balcony glazing can be closed to create a bright and comfortable solarium with unobstructed views. This is one of the major benefits of our system.
On warm summer days, you can slide the retractable glazing fully or partially open, letting you enjoy your outdoor balcony however you like.
Enhanced security: balcony glazing adds an extra layer of security, deterring intruders and preventing unauthorised access to your balcony.
Energy efficiency: balcony glazing can help reduce energy costs by preventing heat loss in the winter and heat retention in the summer.
Design your balcony

Designing your balcony can be an exciting and fulfilling experience. It’s a chance to create a space that reflects your style, personality, and lifestyle while providing a peaceful sanctuary that you can retreat to at any time.

Frequently Asked Questions about Balcony Glazing
What is balcony glazing?
Balcony glazing is a system of glass panels installed around a balcony to protect the space from wind, rain, snow, dust, and noise while maintaining outdoor views and natural ventilation. Lumon balcony glazing uses frameless retractable or sliding glass panels that can be opened or closed depending on weather conditions.

Does balcony glazing make a balcony warmer?
Balcony glazing can help create a more comfortable balcony environment by reducing wind and weather exposure. While balcony glazing is not intended as thermal insulation for indoor living space, it can help moderate temperature changes and extend balcony usability throughout the year.

Can balcony glazing reduce noise?
Yes. Balcony glazing can help reduce outdoor noise levels by creating an additional glass barrier between the balcony and the surrounding environment. Noise reduction depends on the glazing structure, balcony design, and surrounding conditions.

Is frameless balcony glazing safe?
Frameless balcony glazing systems are designed using durable tempered safety glass and tested for weather resistance, wind loads, and everyday use. Lumon glazing systems are manufactured according to strict quality and safety standards.

Can balcony glazing increase property value?
A glazed balcony can improve balcony usability, appearance, and weather protection, which may positively influence property attractiveness and long-term value. Many homeowners also appreciate the added outdoor living space created by balcony glazing.

Our balcony glazing offers significant advantages over both open balconies and fixed-glazing systems. With the possibility to open and close as needed, our glazing provides unparalleled flexibility and comfort.

Terrace Glazing
Lumon Terrace Glazing

Lumon terrace glazing transforms terraces and patios into stylish multi-purpose spaces that can be enjoyed in different weather conditions throughout the year. Frameless sliding and retractable glass systems provide protection from wind and rain while preserving natural light and outdoor views. Terrace glazing helps extend outdoor living space, reduce maintenance needs, and improve everyday comfort at home.

Gain extra space for your home with terrace glazing

Lumon terrace glazing is a stylish way to bring more space and comfort to living! It not only looks stylish, but also extends the terrace season and brings more ways to enjoy everyday life: convert that unused space into a home office, a children’s playground, a small garden, a reading corner – you name it. At best, terrace glazing extends the use of the terrace by many months every year. Glazing your terrace turns it into a real multipurpose room for the whole family.

Lumon terrace glazing is elegance, preservation and exceptional quality

Our frameless terrace glazing provides many benefits that increase the quality of your home, including more living space, reduced maintenance and repairs, energy savings and safety. Our frameless glazing systems can be opened during warm weather and closed during windy, rainy or cold conditions.

Use of space and placement of terrace furniture

When planning a terrace space, you should consider what functions you want to fit into your terrace space. Think about how you plan to place your furniture, whether the room can fit a dining table for many people, and in which direction the doors open.

Terrace Glazing Questions Answered
What is terrace glazing?
Terrace glazing is a retractable or sliding glass system designed to protect terraces and patios from weather while maintaining outdoor visibility and natural light. Terrace glazing creates a flexible indoor-outdoor living experience.

Can terrace glazing be used year-round?
Terrace glazing helps extend terrace usability across multiple seasons by protecting the space from rain, wind, and dirt. The system can be opened during warm weather and closed during colder or wetter conditions.

Does terrace glazing require planning permission?
Planning permission requirements vary by country, municipality, and property type. Homeowners should always check local building regulations before installing terrace glazing.

How do you clean terrace glazing?
Lumon terrace glazing panels are designed to be movable and accessible, making both sides of the glass easier to clean safely from inside the terrace area.

What are the benefits of frameless terrace glazing?
Frameless terrace glazing provides weather protection while preserving open views, natural light, and modern architectural appearance. It also helps create more functional outdoor living space with minimal visual obstruction.

How do you clean terrace glazing?
Lumon terrace glazing panels are designed to be movable and accessible, making both sides of the glass easier to clean safely from inside the terrace area.

What are the benefits of frameless terrace glazing?
Frameless terrace glazing provides weather protection while preserving open views, natural light, and modern architectural appearance. It also helps create more functional outdoor living space with minimal visual obstruction.
